goal: Fix the Current tab button for claude.ai/cowork artifact links, make list names optional (named after their addresses) with required fields marked, add a copy button to artifact links, and make starting a new share after a run obvious.

features.description: A claude.ai/cowork link with an artifact open (…/cowork/{session}?artifact={uuid}#…) is accepted as an artifact in the Share tab
steps: Open the side panel of the fake build and go to the Share tab
Paste https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01DaqAfCToHd3TK71TZvnXNn?artifact=e86b11e3-af91-40ad-8816-8deb3031e303#6767e92a-ac5 into Artifacts
See the Artifacts count show 1 and no 'Not artifact links' hint
Tick a list and click Preview
See one artifact card whose link is the matching https://claude.ai/artifact/{base58 id} link (the same id a claude.ai/chat/…?artifact= link with that uuid gives), with its To invite numbers

features.description: A cowork link and the claude.ai/artifact link for the same artifact count as one artifact, and cowork links without a valid artifact uuid are rejected
steps: In the Share tab, paste the cowork link from F001 and, on the next line, the claude.ai/artifact link it maps to
See the Artifacts count show 1, and Preview shows one artifact card
Replace the text with https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01DaqAfCToHd3TK71TZvnXNn (no ?artifact=)
See the hint 'Not artifact links: …' naming that link
Replace it with https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01DaqAfCToHd3TK71TZvnXNn?artifact=not-a-uuid and see the same hint

features.description: + Current tab adds the artifact open in a claude.ai/cowork tab, and opening the panel on such a tab fills it in
steps: Open https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01DaqAfCToHd3TK71TZvnXNn?artifact=e86b11e3-af91-40ad-8816-8deb3031e303#6767e92a-ac5 in the active tab (in e2e, serve the page with a route so nothing reaches claude.ai)
Open the side panel: see Artifacts already filled with the matching https://claude.ai/artifact/{id} link
Clear Artifacts and click + Current tab
See the same link added once, with no error; click + Current tab again and see it is not added twice

features.description: + Current tab on a cowork session with no artifact open explains why nothing was added
steps: Make https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01DaqAfCToHd3TK71TZvnXNn (no ?artifact=) the active tab
Type a valid artifact link into Artifacts, then click + Current tab
See the error 'The current tab is not a claude.ai artifact.'
See the Artifacts text unchanged

features.description: Required fields are marked with *, and the list name is labelled as optional
steps: In the Lists tab, click New list
See the label 'Email addresses *' and the label 'List name (optional)'; the * is visual only and the addresses field is marked required for screen readers (aria-required)
Open an existing list from the Lists tab and see the same labels
In the Share tab, see the label 'Artifacts *', and the same labels in the inline + New list form

features.description: A new list saved without a name is named after its addresses: one address → that address; two → 'a & b'; more → 'a & b +N emails'
steps: In the Lists tab, click New list, leave the name empty, enter ana@example.com and click Save list
See a list named 'ana@example.com' with 1 person
Make another list with no name and ana@example.com, bo@example.com
See a list named 'ana@example.com & bo@example.com'
Make a list with no name and four addresses cy@example.com, di@example.com, ed@example.com, fi@example.com
See a list named 'cy@example.com & di@example.com +2 emails' (with three addresses it reads '+1 email')
The addresses used are the first ones in the order they were entered, after duplicates are dropped

features.description: While the name is empty, the name field's placeholder shows the name the list will get
steps: In the Lists tab, click New list and leave the name empty
See the name placeholder 'List name, e.g. Acme clients'
Type ana@example.com and bo@example.com into Email addresses
See the name placeholder change to 'ana@example.com & bo@example.com'
Type a name: it replaces the placeholder and is the name that gets saved

features.description: An automatic name never clashes with an existing list, and a name of only spaces counts as empty
steps: Save a list with no name and ana@example.com: it is named 'ana@example.com'
Save another list with no name and ana@example.com
See it saved as 'ana@example.com (2)' with no 'already exists' error; a third becomes 'ana@example.com (3)'
Save a list whose name is only spaces, with bo@example.com
See it named 'bo@example.com'
Typing an existing list's name by hand still shows 'A list called "…" already exists.'

features.description: Clearing the name of an existing list and saving names it after its addresses
steps: Make a list named 'Design team' with ana@example.com and bo@example.com
Open it in the Lists tab, clear the name and click Save
See the list renamed 'ana@example.com & bo@example.com' with no 'Give the list a name.' error
Its addresses and permission are unchanged

features.description: In the Share tab, an unnamed new list typed in the inline form is saved with its automatic name when you click Preview
steps: In the Share tab, add an artifact link and click + New list
Leave the name empty, enter ana@example.com and bo@example.com
Click Preview
See the preview header label 'ana@example.com & bo@example.com', and the Lists tab now has a list with that name, ticked in Share with

features.description: A list with neither a name nor addresses, or with invalid addresses, still can't be saved
steps: In the Lists tab, click New list and click Save list with everything empty
See 'Add at least one email address.' and no list created
Leave the name empty and enter ana@example.com and not-an-email, then click Save list
See 'Fix or remove the invalid addresses: not-an-email' and no list created
In the Share tab, the same empty or invalid inline form makes Preview show the same message and not preview

features.description: Each artifact link in the Preview has a copy button that copies the link
steps: Make a list, add an artifact link in the Share tab and click Preview
See a copy button (accessible name 'Copy link') beside each artifact's link
Click it
The clipboard holds that artifact's full https://claude.ai/artifact/… link, and the button shows a check with the name 'Copied' for about 2 seconds, then goes back to 'Copy link'
Clicking the link text itself still opens the artifact in a new tab
Copying needs no new manifest permission (no clipboardWrite), so updating the extension shows no new permission prompt

features.description: Each artifact link in the run view has the same copy button, while the run is going and after it has finished
steps: Send invites to two artifacts
While the run is running, click the copy button beside the first artifact and see the clipboard hold its link and the button show 'Copied'
When the run is Done, click the copy button beside the second artifact
See the clipboard hold the second artifact's link

features.description: If the clipboard refuses, the copy button says it couldn't copy instead of failing silently
steps: Make the clipboard write fail (in e2e, make navigator.clipboard.writeText reject)
In the Preview, click the copy button beside an artifact
See the button show 'Couldn't copy' (accessible name and tooltip) for a moment, then return to 'Copy link'
The panel keeps working: the link can still be opened, and Send still works

features.description: When a run finishes, the run view says it's finished and offers one obvious primary 'Start a new share' button
steps: Send invites to a list with ana@example.com and fail@example.com and wait for Done
At the top of the run card, see a message saying the share is finished, with what happened (e.g. '1 invited, 1 failed')
See a primary (filled), full-width 'Start a new share' button in the run card; no other button competes with it
Reload the panel and see the same finished view and button

features.description: 'Start a new share' after a finished run goes straight to a fresh Share form, without a confirmation
steps: Finish a run as in F015, with the Lists tab's default selection set to one list
Click 'Start a new share'
See no confirmation dialog
See the Share form: Artifacts empty (or the current tab's artifact if it is one), Share with ticked per the default selection, no preview, no leftover error, and focus in the Artifacts field
Add an artifact link, Preview and Send, and see a new run start

features.description: A stopped run with invites left asks before it is discarded, and Cancel keeps it resumable
steps: Send invites to a list of several addresses and click Stop while some are still pending
See the run Stopped with Resume and a 'Start a new share' button (Resume is the primary one)
Click 'Start a new share' and dismiss the confirmation: the stopped run stays, with Resume
Click 'Start a new share' again and accept: see the fresh Share form as in F016
A stopped run with nothing left goes to the Share form without a confirmation

features.description: The README describes the optional list name, the required-field markers, cowork links, the copy button and 'Start a new share'
steps: Read README 'Use it': Make a list says the name is optional and how the automatic name is made; fields marked * are required
Pick artifacts says links from a chat or a cowork session with the artifact open work, as do + Current tab
Check the preview / Watch it run mention the copy button beside each artifact link
Watch it run and the How it works flowchart say 'Start a new share'
docs/claude-share-api.md lists the claude.ai/cowork/{session}?artifact={uuid} link form
npm run check passes (Prettier formats the Markdown)
